text:
jim_customer: Hey team — our Dedicated tenant `ledgerpay` started hitting a bunch of 429s this morning around 08:12 UTC. Most requests are long-context (token ~12k) and we're seeing throttles even though we should be within qps. Example error from client: `HTTP 429: throttled - kv_cache_pressure`. Can you take a look?

maria_support: sorry you're hitting this, we're looking. Do you have a request id or sample payload/ts?

jim_customer: sample request_id: r_20260315_081205_9f3a. Payload is a multi-turn archive concat (~12k tokens). Happening on model `gpt-large-16k` pinned.

opsbot: [alert] tenant=ledgerpay metric=kv_evictions/s value=118 threshold=50 window=60s

opsbot: [alert] tenant=ledgerpay kv_alloc_percent=96% hostpool=dedicated-us-east-2

sara_sre: pinging infra, looks like KV cache evictions are spiking which triggers per-tenant throttling path. Can you grab the runtime eviction log and autoscale events?

alex_infra: grabbing logs now. tail from runtime:
```
2026-03-15T08:11:58Z INFO KVCache evict start tenant=ledgerpay evicted=512 alloc_used=0.95 frag=0.72
2026-03-15T08:12:01Z WARN KVCache high_pressure tenant=ledgerpay evict_rate=120/s prefix_hits=0.04
2026-03-15T08:12:03Z INFO Autoscaler decision tenant=ledgerpay action=scale_up reason=kv_pressure desired_gpus=2 -> current_gpus=1
2026-03-15T08:12:04Z WARN Autoscaler backoff tenant=ledgerpay action=deferred last_scale=2026-03-15T08:11:00 backoff_s=900
```

alex_infra: autoscaler wanted to scale but we were in backoff window from a scale-down a minute earlier, so the scale up was deferred. That combined with high eviction+fragmentation explains the throttles.

maria_support: oh — so it's not just noisy neighbor, it's also autoscale timing + memory fragmentation. Any noisy tenants on the same pool?

alex_infra: checking colocated tenants on pool `dedicated-us-east-2`: `media-ops` had bursty long-context workloads starting 08:10 which likely pushed the KV usage and caused fragmentation.

sara_sre: quick repro steps for us if someone wants to run locally against a repro cluster:
```
# hammer the dedicated endpoint with long contexts
for i in {1..40}; do 
  curl -sS -X POST https://dedicated-us-east-2.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"gpt-large-16k","input":"'$(head -c 12000 /dev/urandom | base64)'"}' &
done
```

sara_sre: also capture runtime metrics: `kubectl logs -l svc=runtime -n redwood | grep ledgerpay` and `redis info` on the KV nodes.

alex_infra: here's a snippet showing fragmentation numbers around the spike: `mem_frag_ratio=0.71` and frequent small evictions which reduces effective capacity.

maria_support: recommended mitigations (short term):
- temporarily increase tenant_kv_quota for ledgerpay to 1.5x from platform console (removes immediate throttle)
- bump autoscale min_cooldown to avoid thrash but also reduce min_backoff so scale-ups aren't blocked for too long
- if possible, advise the customer to send fewer ultra-long histories or use summary prompts to reduce context length

sara_sre: medium-term fixes:
- introduce eviction hysteresis before per-tenant throttles trigger (e.g., require sustained evict_rate>threshold for 60s)
- tune allocator to reduce fragmentation (coalesce free slabs / larger allocation buckets for long-context workloads)
- enable tenant isolation on that pool or migrate ledgerpay to a less noisy pool

infra-oncall: I'm going to open ENG ticket to track allocator & autoscaler interplay: ENG-48921. I'll put a runbook note: when kv_alloc_percent>90% and autoscale is in backoff, auto-increase temporary quota and notify oncall.

alex_infra: for immediate troubleshooting I ran a controlled repro and saw the same behaviour: evict_rate jumps then 429s within ~30s if sustained. Pasted minimal repro curl above.

jim_customer: thanks, can you increase the quota temporarily? We're in the middle of a settlement job.

maria_support: done — increased ledgerpay tenant_kv_quota by 1.5x at 08:17 UTC. Please confirm if errors stop.

jim_customer: checking... early signs look better, a few remaining 429s but significantly reduced. I'll rerun heavy job next 15m and report.

sara_sre: good. keeping this thread open. After the job finishes, please send the request_ids for any remaining 429s and we'll correlate with eviction windows.

opsbot: [note] action=ticket_created ENG-48921 assignee=alex_infra priority=high

jim_customer: will do. appreciate the quick patch.

maria_support: follow-ups: we'll schedule a pool migration if ledgerpay continues long-context bursts; infra will look at allocator tuning and autoscaler cooldown policy.

sara_sre: also adding a short-term monitoring alert: new rule to fire when (kv_alloc_percent>85% && autoscaler_backoff=true) for 30s.

infra-oncall: assigned ENG-48921 to Alex, ETA for initial allocator change: 2 weeks, but we will attempt to apply throttling hysteresis this week as a config change.

jim_customer: thanks all — will update after the next run.

maria_support: closing loop once you confirm stable. :thumbsup:
